PLS-G1: closed — the return-code-keyed fee factors are gone from every assessed fee: the late fee's fee form is replaced by a pay-cycle form (one late charge per missed pay cycle across Larkspur credit: shared by amounts past due / two cycles within one schedule maximum / schedule figure) plus a loan-tenure share; the returned fee's return-reason share is replaced by a returned-fee AutoPay share (cleared AutoPay debits); no fee computation reads a return code to set its amount (the courtesy point that weighs why a payment failed is a discretionary waiver and stays).
PLS-G2(a): closed — the bank-event form now reads, and the rule now states, the borrower's latest FlexLine returned payment and latest FlexLine returned-payment fee with a first-recorded tie rule; tier 2 is implemented as "not that one bank event"; the same latest-with-tie wording is applied to the new pay-cycle form's FlexLine late fee read.
PLS-G2(b): closed — the AutoPay courtesy point is restated to match its reads: latest enrollment and latest cancellation of any reason, each with a first-recorded tie rule and the same-date enrollment-is-later rule, then the cancellation's reason is tested.
PLS-G2(c): closed — the PracticePay point no longer reads a first-match holding field: tier 1 is existential over paid-in-full plans, tier 2 is an active plan with no PracticePay late fee on any plan in the last 12 whole months; the world seeds the PracticePay ledger and a read node reaches it; every other holding read was swept (FlexLine reads name the borrower's single open line; Credit Builder active-account reads are existential; completed-modification reads are one per loan).
PLS-G2(d): closed — the return-reason courtesy point states the first-recorded tie rule for same-date returns; every remaining LATEST read in every policy now states its tie rule.
PLS-G2(e): closed — the refinance quote's hold excludes an additional-principal payment that has already been returned (its return already restored it), in rule, compute and ladder.
PLS-G2(f): closed — the returned-fee policy states that it assesses the latest returned payment (fees on earlier fee-bearing returns are charged at the schedule amount, unreduced), and the courtesy waiver's returned-fee prerequisite sentence and condition are narrowed to the latest returned payment, so one write brings the state about.
PLS-G2(g): closed — every policy that counts whole calendar months now states the same convention (difference in months, less one when the later day of the month is smaller), which is exactly what the computation does; month-end probes recorded.
PLS-G3: closed — the late-fee prerequisite sentence and its condition now name the late fee owed for the oldest unpaid installment once its grace period has ended, exactly what the late-fee policy assesses.
O-1: closed — the AutoPay-off window tier now anchors on the end of that installment's late-fee grace period, a different anchor from the AutoPay-on tier (day before the due date) and the fixed count.
O-2: closed — the grade-proportional remaining-term reduction is replaced by a remaining-term credit in fixed points, distinct on every grade; the grade's refinance reduction stays a plain baseline quantity.
O-3: closed — the repeat-courtesy ladder is monotone (a courtesy within 12 months gives the share less a retained amount, 12–23 months the share, none the whole unpaid part); tier reachability by grade follows the base courtesy allowance.
O-4: closed — the AutoPay debit counts in the AutoPay discount step, the late-fee AutoPay share and the returned-fee AutoPay share all count debits less those returned; the re-quote cushion is kept with its rationale recorded.
O-5: closed — the refinance policy declares, with self-scope, the overwrite of the base "fee is withheld from the loan amount" sentence for its add-on sizing form.
O-6: closed — the late-fee rule states that under schedule_c the schedule figure is its flat amount in every form.
O-7: closed — no change of design; fee figures follow the stated multiplication with one rounding.
O-8: closed — the courtesy-waiver tool's fee-line argument now points only at the loan ledger.
O-9: closed — every task tool now stores money and rates with the same rounding the computations use, and the docstrings say "rounded to the cent".
O-10: closed — the AutoPay-on window tier requires the next due date to be at least 2 days away, so the window is never zero days.
T0-O1: closed — the seeded earlier refinance quote that carries a re-quote cushion is recomputed under the refinance-quote rule in force on its date (its re-quote cushion included); seed consistency text updated.
T1-O1: closed — no change: the opening line names the object of the request (the late fee she expects), conveys no amount and names no prerequisite; rationale recorded in the worklog.
T1-O2: closed — the world now assesses returned-payment fees at the borrower's next contact (the earlier returned fees are dated on her calls), so the unbooked fee on the latest return is consistent with the seeded history.
